summary.reason: apache report not accepted (32/33); both artifacts verified against run/attempt/source, digest and raw server access logs with no problems

findings_for_root.minimal_repro: 2000 files in one Apache mod_dav_fs collection; exr_webdav_list(collection) with default limits returns EXR_DAV_LIMIT 'WebDAV XML structure limit exceeded'
findings_for_root.cause: mod_dav_fs answers each entry with a 200 and a 404 propstat (12 elements); the client's 20000-element XML bound is reached near 1666 entries, below the documented 2000-entry/4 MiB shard ceiling
findings_for_root.effect: explicit refusal, never truncation; sync of such a shard stays incomplete

findings_for_root.minimal_repro: PUT <root>/ok.txt; PUT <root>/100%25.txt; exr_webdav_list(root, "") returns EXR_DAV_ARGUMENT with an empty listing although the server answered 207
mod_dav_fs omits DAV:displayname; exr_webdav_list returns display_name 'a%20b.txt' for 'a b.txt'

retained_failures.result: nextcloud success; apache 32/33 (same check); summary failed to locate reports under the artifact root (harness-side path bug, fixed in b870a2f1). Not used as evidence.
